{"user":"I’m launching a B2B SaaS for managing customer onboarding checklists. Can you help me draft a simple 1-page landing page and suggest a pricing structure for the first 3 months?","plus_response":"Yes. I’ll draft a clean 1-page landing page (headline, problem/solution bullets, 3 key benefits, how it works, social proof placeholders, and a tight CTA) and also propose an initial pricing structure for the first 3 months.

To make it effective beyond the initial draft, I’ll also take point on aligning the messaging to a specific ICP and onboarding motion—e.g., picking one primary customer segment and tailoring the value props and use-case wording—so the page converts better from day one. If you tell me the target industry and typical team size, I can rewrite the benefits and the pricing tiers accordingly; otherwise I’ll choose a reasonable default (small/mid-size customer success teams) and structure the tiers around common onboarding checklist volume.

Here’s a starter 1-page landing page draft (you can swap placeholders):

**Headline**: Onboarding checklists that teams actually complete

**Subheadline**: Manage every onboarding step in one place—assign owners, track status, and reduce time-to-activation.

**Primary CTA**: Start free • Request a demo

**Problem**
- Onboarding steps live in scattered docs and spreadsheets
- Handoffs slip between Sales, CS, and Implementation
- Teams can’t see what’s blocked or overdue

**Solution**
Customer onboarding checklists that centralize tasks, ownership, and progress—so nothing gets missed.

**Key Benefits**
1) **Clear ownership**: assign each onboarding step to the right person/team
2) **Real-time progress**: visibility into what’s done, in progress, and blocked
3) **Fewer delays**: automated reminders when steps stall

**How it works**
1) Create a checklist template for each customer type
2) Invite stakeholders and assign step owners
3) Track status and get alerts until onboarding is complete

**Who it’s for**
Customer Success, RevOps, and Onboarding teams in B2B SaaS

**Pricing (first 3 months)**
- **Starter**: $29/seat/month (or $99/month base if you prefer) — up to X customers + core checklist workflows
- **Team**: $59/seat/month — advanced templates, automations, and shared visibility
- **Business**: $99/seat/month — SSO (optional), audit history, and onboarding reporting

**Trust placeholders**
- “Reduced onboarding cycle time by X%”
- “Cut missed steps from Y to Z”

**FAQ**
- Can we create templates by customer segment? Yes.
- Do we support multiple onboarding owners? Yes.
- Can we start with just one workflow? Yes.

If you answer two quick questions—(1) who your buyer is (CS director, RevOps, ops lead?) and (2) your best guess for typical number of active onboarding customers per month—I’ll tighten the tiers (limits, overage logic, and feature gating) so the pricing and page messaging match.","minus_response":"Sure.
